title: High-Precision Robot Assembly Line Successfully Deployed at a Well-Known Home Appliance Manufacturer
contentHtml:
TXAM has successfully completed the installation and commissioning of a custom high-precision robot assembly line for a well-known home appliance manufacturer, which is now officially in production.

Project Background

This home appliance manufacturer operates multiple modern production lines both domestically and internationally, with extremely stringent requirements for the precision and stability of automation equipment. Leveraging 19 years of industry experience and technical expertise, TXAM won the bid and undertook the design and delivery of this major project.

Technical Highlights

The entire line uses TXAM's self-developed UVW vision alignment platform, combined with six-axis industrial robots, achieving assembly precision of ±0.1mm. With CAD import one-click changeover functionality, the entire line can complete product switching within 15 minutes, greatly enhancing production flexibility.

After project delivery, the customer's single-line production cycle time was reduced to 12 seconds per unit, with a yield rate exceeding 99.9%, earning high recognition from the customer.
